vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Magnetic _____ due to currents current flows through the circuit.
vsaq.answer: Magnetic field due to currents current flows through the circuit.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: B of electro _____ induction an induced current is generated in the coil.
vsaq.answer: B of electro magnetic induction an induced current is generated in the coil.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: So our assumed clockwise direction of induced _____ is wrong.
vsaq.answer: So our assumed clockwise direction of induced current is wrong.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Use the right thumb rule to find the _____ of force.
vsaq.answer: Use the right thumb rule to find the direction of force.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: We know that this _____ is always directed perpendicular to velocity.
vsaq.answer: We know that this force is always directed perpendicular to velocity.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: In _____ motor, electrical energy is converted into mechanical energy.
vsaq.answer: In electric motor, electrical energy is converted into mechanical energy.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: In this way conservation of energy takes place in electromagnetic _____.
vsaq.answer: In this way conservation of energy takes place in electromagnetic induction.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: This work done on the _____ is converted into electrical energy in the coil.
vsaq.answer: This work done on the magnet is converted into electrical energy in the coil.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: In generators, mechanical _____ is converted into electrical energy.
vsaq.answer: In generators, mechanical energy is converted into electrical energy.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The _____ is oriented in such a way that I its south pole points towards the north pole of the coil.
vsaq.answer: The needle is oriented in such a way that I its south pole points towards the north pole of the coil.
